7.11 CAN XL Extension
The CAN XL Transceiver Driver is implemented as an extension for the existing CAN
Transceiver Driver (see [5, Specification of Can XL]), non CAN XL hardware will still
use basic CAN Transceiver Driver implementation.
The CAN XL Transceiver Driver is an extension of CAN Transceiver Driver and intro-
duces an additional API to support Ethernet interface and provides a mode interface
to CAN XL Transceiver Driver (see [5, Specification of Can XL] for further details).
